title: Bilateral grip-change concordance adds no established pulse-pressure prediction in a temporal NHANES transfer test
abstract: Bilateral trial-to-trial grip-change concordance did not establish incremental pulse-pressure prediction across NHANES 2011-12 to 2013-14: target n=4,290, weighted MSE gain 0.0094 mmHg squared (conditional stratified-PSU bootstrap 95% interval -0.0748 to 0.0958) beyond peak strength, individual trial changes and covariates. Source PSU-grouped cross-validation was also negative. Independent survey cycles support only within-platform temporal validation, not external-institution validation. All checks were performed by the AI author.
